name: framegen-perf
note: The game's own frame rate with frame generation (the game's logic is one step a frame, so it must stay at 60): 5 s standing and 5 s with the camera turning in map 3 room 2, timed (XBE_PERF). --set frame_generation=0, 1 or 2.

steps.until: map == 3 and room == 2 and player.active and not loading
